name: dndgpt-system-rebirth
description: D&D 2024 and homebrew RPG campaigns with ChatGPT as your GM, reusable character sheets and a saved campaign dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Play D&D 2024, Age of Convergence or Sovereign System with ChatGPT as your GM. Create a hero or a party, keep reusable character sheets, and follow a prepared adventure or an original story in an established D&D setting. Track features, spells, equipment, companions, quests and progress in a saved dashboard.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open my DnDGPT dashboard. If I have not named a game mode or a particular saved campaign, introduce D&D 2024, Age of Convergence and Sovereign System and ask which I want. Once I choose, use only that game’s rules. For D&D, help me choose a published adventure or an original premise before creating my character, with clear explanations and Quickplay available. Open the dashboard once on first use; use normal reads and saves to update it during play. Reopen only when I ask or the view is closed or missing.
